newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN STABILISING AFTER FALLS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN STABILISING AFTER FALLS.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to stabilise on Wednesday after four consecutive falls on the back of strong buying after price fixing and mixed constinuous trade on Tuesday.
Some analysts said shares could post moderate gains as prices were beginning to look attractive after the main all-share WIG index fell 4.5 percent since last Thursday.
Analysts said ZEW which started bourse trade on Monday 20 percent below issue, but jumped 10 percent to 39.6 zlotys on Tuesday, was likely to extend gains.
